en.headline: M+ presents Myths and Monsters survey of Asian fantasy art
en.dek: The exhibition is described as the first major survey exploring two centuries of Asian fantasy visual culture, featuring more than 400 works across fine art, film, fashion and games.
body: M+ has opened “Myths and Monsters: The Art of Fantasy in Asia”, billed as the first major survey of two centuries of Asian fantasy visual culture.

The exhibition spans four thematic sections and includes more than 400 works drawn from fine art, architecture, fashion, video games and film. It traces fantasy storytelling from 19th-century folklore through Asian surrealism to contemporary pop-culture icons such as Godzilla and Ghost in the Shell.
Public programmes accompanying the show include lectures, interactive digital experiences, film screenings at M+ Cinema and a companion research publication.
The West Kowloon museum said the display examines how artists have used fantastical narratives to respond to changing social and political conditions.

zh.headline: M+呈獻《神話與怪物》亞洲幻想藝術大型展覽
zh.dek: 展覽被形容為首個全面探討兩個世紀亞洲幻想視覺文化的大型調查，展出逾400件跨越純藝術、電影、時裝及遊戲的作品。
body: M+博物館推出「神話與怪物：亞洲幻想藝術」展覽，據稱是首個系統梳理兩個世紀亞洲幻想視覺文化的大型調查。
展覽分為四個主題部分，匯集逾400件作品，涵蓋純藝術、建築、時裝、電子遊戲及電影。內容從19世紀民間傳說、亞洲超現實主義，一直延伸至哥斯拉及《攻殼機動隊》等當代流行文化標誌。
展覽同期設有講座、互動數碼體驗、M+戲院電影放映及相關研究出版物。
西九文化區博物館表示，展覽探討藝術家如何以幻想敘事回應不斷轉變的社會及政治環境。
